messages:
Maria Gonzalez: Hi team :wave: I just unboxed my kit and the USB-C to Ethernet dongle is missing from the box. The monitor and dock are here though.
it-support-bot: Sorry about that, Maria. I've created ticket #IT-4821 and flagged shipping. Can you confirm the part you expected (photo/link would help)? :package:
Maria Gonzalez: It was the small black dongle that came in a little cardboard sleeve, labeled 'AN-ETH-USB-C'. No photo from the box, I discarded packing after opening. Shipping label says 'Standard Kit - US'.
Luke Chen: Hey Maria — I'm on call for onboarding today. Can you DM me a photo of the packing slip? Also, did the dock have the little foam pouch where the dongle usually tucks in?
Maria Gonzalez: Sent the packing slip in DM. The foam pouch looks like it was empty, yeah.
Sarah Patel: Welcome Maria! For visibility, I've added the ticket to the new-hires queue and asked Shipping to do a same-week replacement. :white_check_mark:
Shipping Bot: Replacement request submitted (tracking pending). ETA 3 business days. Ref: SHIP-99012. :truck:
Maria Gonzalez: Thanks all — appreciate the quick response. Do I need to return anything?
it-support-bot: No return needed for the damaged/missing accessory. When the replacement arrives, please test the Ethernet and confirm here. If Shipping asks for a photo of the original packaging, please keep one until replacement delivered.
Maria Gonzalez: Will do. Quick follow-up — the monitor stand had a loose screw but I tightened it. Noted for future shipments.
Luke Chen: Good note, filing as feedback to ops. If the replacement doesn't arrive by Fri ping me and I'll escalate.
Maria Gonzalez: Thanks Luke, Sarah, team :thumbsup:
